1. Allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. The applications stand disposed of.

3. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No.938/2023 dated 12.08.2023 registered under Sections 376/354A/34 IPC at PS: Sadar Bazar, Delhi.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
She seeks, and is granted, two weeks to file the Status Report alongwith the SCRB Report, MLC and/ or PMR, if needed.
6. At this stage, learned counsel appearing for the applicant submits that the applicant has always been willing to join and participate in the BAIL APPLN.
